name: xsd-to-ir
description: Parse XSD schemas into an IR — generate DB schema, JSON Schema, and round-trip XML↔DB for S3000L

notes.better-sqlite3: SQLite driver — useful for local dev/test (optionalDependencies).
notes.libxmljs2: Native libxml2 bindings for full XSD 1.0 validation (optionalDependencies). Requires node-gyp. Falls back to structural check if absent.
